main_measure.name: mean 30-bar forward return minus the coin's normal 30-bar drift, over grid bars with forecast > 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and the check's difference > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual return of the larger-forecast half minus the smaller-forecast half

decided_by: The main mean's t is between -2 and 2 (or undefined), meeting neither the confirm nor the reject rule.
reading: Cases are grid bars (positions 0, 30, 60, ... of each window) with forecast > 0 and a close 30 bars later in the same window; the normal drift is the mean of the coin's 30-bar grid returns over all its windows; the day-clustered t sums deviations per calendar day with a D/(D-1) correction; the halves are the top and bottom n//2 cases by forecast (the middle case left out when n is odd); fewer than 30 case days is reported as 'not observable' as the plan's minimum count.
